description_en: Queries BGP groups in a specified region
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-bgp-groups --router-id vbr-bp1ctxy813985gkuk0000 --bgp-group-id bgpg-bp1k25cyp26cllath0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --is-default false --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBgpGroups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VBR associated with the BGP group
parameters.name: router_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BGP group
parameters.name: bgp_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VBR. 

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VBR所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the BGP group is the default BGP group. Valid values:

false: The BGP group is not the default BGP group.
true: The BGP group is the default BGP group
parameters.help_zh:
是否为默认BGP组。取值：

false：不是默认BGP组。
true：是默认BGP组
parameters.name: is_default

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

BgpGroup.description_en: The details of the BGP group

AuthKey.description_en: The key used by the BGP group

BgpGroupId.description_en: The ID of the BGP group

Description.description_en: The description of the BGP group

Hold.description_en:
The hold time for waiting for incoming BGP messages, in seconds.

If no message is received within the hold time, the BGP peer is considered disconnected
Hold.description_zh:
等待BGP消息传入的保持时间，单位为秒。

如果超过保持时间还没有消息传入，则认为BGP邻居断开了连接

IpVersion.description_en:
The IP version of the BGP group. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4.
IPv6: IPv6. IPv6 is supported only when the VBR for which the BGP group is created has the enable IPv6 feature activated
IpVersion.description_zh:
BGP组的IP版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4版本。
IPv6：IPv6版本，只有当创建BGP组的VBR开通IPv6功能时，支持IPv6版本

IsFake.description_en:
Indicates whether the AS number is fake. Valid values:

false: The AS number is not fake.
true: The AS number is fake
IsFake.description_zh:
AS号是否为假。取值：

false：否。
true：是

LocalAsn.description_en: The AS number on the Alibaba Cloud side

Name.description_en: The name of the BGP group

PeerAsn.description_en: The AS number of the on-premises device on the data center side

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the BGP group

RouteLimit.description_en: The maximum number of routing entries that can be learned through BGP dynamic routing
RouteLimit.description_zh: BGP动态路由学习的路由条目上限

Status.description_en: The status of the BGP group

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数
